title: feat(spec,metadata-protocol)!: rename the type registry's allowOrgOverride to allowEnvironmentOverlay, on the registry and on GET /meta/types
body:
Part of #22340
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

ADR-0131 C5's spec half (stage S2): the metadata type registry's `allowOrgOverride` is renamed to `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, on `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` and on the `GET /meta/types` wire field, under ruling C on #22007 (`6028809298`), ruling `6073921182` (Q1 A, Q2 A) and the pre-build contract review `6109457426`, which fixed the name. #22340 stays open for this PR's next round (the `.objectui-sha` bump) and for S3, the governed text.

⚠️ **Do not land this round alone.** The Studio console reads the wire field under the old name in 12 source files and types it itself, so no gate turns red on a missed rename: Studio would show the five overlay-enabled types read-only. The pin moves in this PR's next round, after the objectui companion (objectstack-ai/objectui#12141) merges; the landing record is the contract review on that post-pin head.

## What changes

- **The key.** `MetadataTypeRegistryEntry.allowEnvironmentOverlay` (default `false`) with the contract review's describe and TSDoc. `allowOrgOverride` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone on `MetadataTypeRegistryEntryBaseSchema` whose prescription names the new key: the old key fails `tsc` and fails the parse (`invalid_type` at `allowOrgOverride`). All 28 built-in rows spell the new key; every value is unchanged (the true set is `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation`, `email_template`).
- **The ledger (ADR-0087).** Retired-keys entry `18.kernel__MetadataTypeRegistryEntry__allowOrgOverride`; D3 semantic entry `metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-renamed`, covering the registry key AND the wire field; its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 94). No D2 conversion, as ruled: no manifest, stack or stored row can carry a registry entry. No `registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json` or upgrade guide is committed (git-ignored, generated).
- **The wire, one spelling.** `getMetaTypes` writes the `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` elevation onto `allowEnvironmentOverlay` on BOTH arms: the registry arm (the `...base` spread already carries the new key, and the elevated value overwrites it) and the synthesised arm of a runtime type with no registry row. No entry carries `allowOrgOverride`. The field's describe says the elevation opens only items no managed package ships; `overrideSource` keeps `registry` / `env` and its describe names the new field.
- **The read-side trap, hand-renamed.** A truthiness reader of the old key compiles against the tombstone and reads `undefined`, which closes all five types. The readers moved by hand: `protocol.ts` `getMetaTypes` (both arms) and `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`, and `sys-metadata-repository.ts`'s `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`. Every test reader moved with them.
- **`supportsOverlay` keeps its name and both keys stay** (contract review item 2: ADR-0049 retires neither). Its TSDoc and its three describes (registry, `GetMetaTypesResponse`, `MetadataTypeInfoResponse`) and the stale read claims in `protocol.ts` and `sys-metadata-repository.ts` now say what it gates: the delete carve-out, no save and no read. **Wording used: PR #22833's**, which landed (`8c105e3d67`) before this branch merged `main`: the removal "removes no managed definition, and changes what is served for `permission` alone".
- **Prose that tied the flag to organization scope** is rewritten, not mechanically renamed: the key's TSDoc and describe, `email-template.zod.ts`, `kernel/index.ts`, the `customizationPolicies` prescription (and its pin), the unreleased D3 `metadata-customization-protocol-retired` and its fragment, and the comments in `protocol.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, runtime `packages.ts` / `mcp.ts` and `sys-flow-credential.object.ts`.
- **The refusal sentences** that named the flag name the new key; codes and statuses are unchanged.
- **Tests.** The 74 files that named the key move to the new key. The 20 files that pin the RETIRED per-organization path label their specimens as the five overlay-enabled types (the set those doors once scoped to an organization), so no label reads as "org-overridable = `allowEnvironmentOverlay`"; their `ORG_OVERRIDABLE` identifiers are now `PRE_D6_ORG_SCOPED`. The two plugin-security doubles throw the sentence the producer emits today.
- **Docs and tooling.** `metadata-lifecycle.mdx`'s whitelist table header moves with `check-overlay-whitelist-table.mjs`'s `COL_FLAG` and its self-test fixtures, in one change; 10 more `content/docs` pages; 8 platform-checklist files, both `metadata-plugin.zod.ts#allowOrgOverride` anchors re-pointed to `#allowEnvironmentOverlay` (revision-history `change` entries keep the old name); 3 liveness notes; 2 ADR anchors; the regenerated references.
- **The changeset** (`major` on the v18 pre-mode line, the `22572` precedent): BREAKING, the FROM / TO table for registry entries and `/meta/types` entries, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and the ADR-0087 `registered` marker.

## New pins

- `kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-retirement.test.ts`: the parse refuses the old key with the rename (code, path, prescription text; `false` refused like `true`); the new key parses and defaults to `false` with no old key grown back; every built-in row states the new key, none the old, and the true set is exactly the five; the retired-keys registration.
- `kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence.test.ts` (`repo` project, radius already declared for `@objectstack/spec#test:repo`): a tree-scoped, AST-read absence of any CODE reference to `allowOrgOverride` in `packages/**/*.ts` and `examples/*/src/**/*.ts`. Comments and strings are history and are not judged; the tombstone declaration is exempt by shape. The sibling refusal pin is counted apart and REQUIRED to be found, so the walk carries a live positive control.
- `objectql/protocol-meta-types-rich.test.ts`: both writer arms carry `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, the hatch elevation lands on it on both arms, and `not.toHaveProperty('allowOrgOverride')` on every entry.
- S1's `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts` under the new name on both topologies, plus the wire absence; the identity pins (`org-scoped-write-refused`, `adr0005-org-override-rollback`, `overlay-precedence`) read the new key.

## Ablation (committed fix first; restored blob-equal)

Dropped the hand rename of `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`'s reader (`if (!entry.allowEnvironmentOverlay) continue;` back to the old key) through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 → 0, mutant 0 → 1 on disk; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`. S1's five-type file: **20 failed / 6 passed of 26** (the 6 are the wire and identity cases, which do not read that set). Restored: blob `eff1a12c83e2` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; preflight `--absent` clean over 24 built files; the same file **26 / 26 passed**.

## Readings

- **Residual `allowOrgOverride` in non-test source** (head `e684a2ec89`): the tombstone, its prescription and TSDoc, the registry's naming note, the retired-keys and D3 entries, the rationale fragment, two shipped protocol-17 D3 entries, `18.metadata-write-organization-scope-refused` (history), the generated `authorable-surface/kernel.json` `[RETIRED]` row and the untouched `authorable-surface.base.json`, three history comments (`protocol.ts` retired exemption, a quoted docs sentence in `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `rest-server.ts`), two ADR-anchor history notes, and the checker's header note. No code reference (the absence pin).
- **Surfaces (spec-property-retirement).** Apply: schema, retired-keys + D3 + fragment, generated baselines (`authorable-surface/kernel.json`, `authorable-defaults/kernel.json`, four reference pages), pin tests (radius declared), examples (one comment), docs, changeset, the `check:generated` source audits and the dogfood radius. Do not apply: orphan value schema (boolean), D2 conversion (ruled out), liveness ledger row (none exists for the registry entry; the three prose notes follow the name), forms and i18n (no `*.form.ts` input), CLI advisory lint (ledger-driven, no row), published skills (S3). `api-surface`, `json-schema.manifest` and `export-origins` do not move (no export renamed); `authorable-surface.base.json` is written only by `gen:authorable-surface-base` and is untouched. `acceptRetiredDefaultResidue` is not needed: no built artifact or stored row carries a registry entry.
- **Size.** 141 files, +1160 / −573 = 1733 changed lines, generated included (generated: +14 / −12; tests: 76 files, +613 / −266). The pin round is estimated at about 600–700 more.

## Not in this PR

- `.objectui-sha` and its manifest regeneration: this PR's next round, after objectui#12141 merges.
- The governed text (S3): `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive 7, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, ADR-0005 (and the dated ADR records).
- cloud's two test helpers (`service-ai-studio` `write-door.ts` and `metadata-tools.test.ts`): recorded on the card (`6109343061` item 5) for a seat that reaches cloud.
- CHANGELOGs and every other pending changeset.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:platform-checklist` is red on this head on 7 findings in `areas/access-security.json` and `areas/attachments-storage.json`, files this PR does not touch; the anchored symbols (`anonymousFormIntakeOrgScopeRefusal`, `anonymousFormIntakeReopenRefusal`, `envWideRawViewRows`, `canEdit`) are absent at the branch's original base `31b5a5f7f5` too (0 / 0). Not this diff.
- The ADR-0087 marker names only the D3 id: the gate resolves ids from the semantic and conversion registries and refused the retired-keys string as an id. The retired-keys entry is named in the changeset body.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:migration-registry` does not exist (the registry is git-ignored and generated); `gen:migration-registry` ran green (423 semantic, 259 retired-key, 222 retired-def).

## Verification (head `e684a2ec89`)

- `@objectstack/spec`: `typecheck` exit 0; `test` (local) 649 files / 19374 tests passed; the absence pin, `retired-key-migrate-sentence` and `step18-rationale-merge` (repo project) passed.
- Suites that name the key, after the closure build (`turbo run build`, 63 tasks): `metadata-protocol` 28 files / 1096 tests, `objectql` 18 / 365, `rest` 9 / 148, `runtime` 7 / 88 (the integration file included), `plugin-security` 2 / 81, `platform-objects` 1 / 10, dogfood 3 / 23, spec 7 / 97, all passed; `typecheck` exit 0 on `metadata-protocol`, `objectql`, `rest`, `runtime`, `plugin-security`, `platform-objects`, `metadata-core`, `lint`, `service-automation`, `dogfood`, `example-showcase`.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exit 0 (`registered metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-renamed`, new here); `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 (pre mode, tag `next`); `check:generated` exit 0 after `--fix` regenerated the references; `check:overlay-whitelist-table` and its self-test exit 0; `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:adr-anchors` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (no paths): every printed command run; the reconciliation and the NOT MEASURED families are in the seat report on #22340. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED (no whole-workspace build, by dispatch).
